patch_description: This replaces the fixed cube-entangling hardware-efficient ansatz with a permutation-equivariant, data-driven alternating-operator circuit. The feature uploads already provide graph-dependent two-qubit interactions, so the ansatz uses collective Euler mixers to convert those encoded phases into measurable populations without introducing an arbitrary fixed topology. Sharing each rotation across all qubits regularizes the model and reinforces gradients, while independent copies across the six blocks retain temporal expressivity. The design uses only 3 parameters per block—20 total including readout—and reduces the full circuit from 348 to 228 gates, improving parameter efficiency, trainability, and expected generalization.
